name: sales_dispatch_dashboard
title: Monthwise Sales Dispatch (sale invoices: MT, value, realisation by month, customer, grade, product)
description: Monthwise sales dispatch / sale invoice MIS from VIEW_SALE_INVOICE_PBI - exact logic of 'Monthwise_Sales_Dispatch_v1.html' (Venus Sale MIS). Use for: '/sales_dispatch_dashboard', 'sales dispatch', 'dispatch report', 'sale invoice report', 'monthwise sales', 'monthwise dispatch', 'realisation', 'sales MIS'. Admin and manager roles only.
rules:
SOURCE
1. Data: VIEW_SALE_INVOICE_PBI (one row per sale invoice line).
2. ALWAYS use run_report_engine(skill_name='sales_dispatch_dashboard', from_date, to_date). Never write SQL for this report.
3. Period = sale bill date. Default = this financial year to date (April 1 to today) because it is a month-wise report. 'last month' / 'yesterday' / a date range work as asked.
4. Dispatch in MT (Kg / 1000), value in Rs Cr (material value), realisation = value / qty in Rs per kg.
OUTPUT
KPI cards, monthwise table + chart, top customers and the Sales Dispatch dashboard (tabs, slicers, Excel export).
output_format: Call run_report_engine ONCE. It delivers KPI cards (dispatch MT, sale value Rs Cr, realisation Rs/kg, invoice lines), the monthwise table, top customers and the live dashboard by itself. Reply with a 2-3 line summary: total, best month, biggest change.
example_output: KPI cards: Dispatch 18,420 MT | Sale value 812.4 Rs Cr | Realisation 441 Rs/kg | 9,812 invoice lines. Monthwise table Apr..Oct, top 20 customers, and the dashboard.
